# Minimal-factorial offline wiring fixture

`cases.json` contains two synthetic cases in each of ten categories. It is not
scientific evidence and must never be used as a claim denominator. The workflow
test uses it only to exercise deterministic smoke scheduling, authorized-lock
loading, and completed-ledger resume behavior without Ollama or a simulator.

Exact 840-episode and 360-baseline analysis gates are exercised separately in
the same test from deterministic in-memory rows. No historical result root is
read or imported.
